messages:
Sam (oncall): quick handoff — summary of tonight's activity and open items. Short version: paging spike at ~22:14 UTC due to delayed logs in the ingestion pipeline, caused alert storm that bubbled into the routing service. We paged, mitigated by enabling regional fallthrough and temporarily raising request timeouts. No customer-facing 5xx spike after fallbacks — confirmed with SRE metrics.

Incident Bot: [22:14:12] Pager: logging-pipeline-delay (P2) triggered: ~1200 alerts in 3m. Escalated to oncall Sam.

Sam (oncall): Timeline: 
- 22:12 — first anomalies in log-forwarder (backpressure counters rising).
- 22:14 — alert storm; routing p95 increased, some per-customer latencies hit 1.8s but no mass 503s.
- 22:17 — enabled regional fallthrough policy (eu-west -> fallback pool) and increased proxy read timeout to 3s.
- 22:20 — alerts subsided, log backlog draining.

Priya: saw a few client retries in frontend logs but only ~0.3% of requests impacted for 30s window. Billing/usage not affected. I pulled a sample request trace: `trace_id=ab12cd34` shows retry then success on fallback.

Marta: ran the runbook step for logging pipeline (link below) and cleared the backlog on the ingesters. Left one node in `ingest-03` in maintenance because it had flaky disk IO.

runbook-bot: Runbook: https://confluence.redwood.ai/runbooks/logging-pipeline — followed steps 1-4, then step 6 for draining.

Theo: action items I took: patched exporter config to reduce batch size (temporary), added a throttling rule in `log-queue` to smooth spikes. Monitoring dashboards updated.

Sam (oncall): customer impact check — ran `slow_query` mem table and checked API error rates: 
```
# quick query
SELECT count(*) FROM api_errors WHERE code >= 500 AND time > now() - interval '10 minutes';
```
Result: 2 errors above 500 in the window, both retries attributed to upstream retries. Confirmed via support slack that no customer tickets opened.

Priya: left note for Support: "Observed transient retry behavior between 22:12-22:21 UTC. No sustained errors. We are monitoring. Contact SRE if you see customer reports."

Marta: follow-ups for next shift: 
- Replace `ingest-03` node (storage IO flakey) — marked in inventory as `repair-required`.
- Add a longer-term fix: increase log-forwarder backpressure threshold tuning (RFC underway).
- Add a short retention alert to catch ingestion lag earlier (low effort).

Theo: posting the temporary mitigation config we applied: 
```
proxy.timeout.read = 3000
log.forwarder.batch_size = 128  # reduced from 512
throttle.log-queue.rate = 500r/s
```

Sam (oncall): coverage for overnight: Priya primary, Marta secondary. If anything spikes again, priority order: 1) enable regional fallthrough, 2) bump proxy timeout, 3) engage migrations team if ingest backlog > 10k messages.

Priya: ack — I'll be on watch and will page if we see >5% p95 shift or any 5xx clustering.

Marta: ack — I'll pick up the node replacement tomorrow morning (09:00 UTC).

Sam (oncall): open items (owners): 
- `ingest-03` replacement — Marta — TODO by 2026-03-20 09:00 UTC
- add retention alert for ingestion lag — Theo — TODO by EOD tomorrow
- RFC for backpressure tuning — Sam — draft posted, review needed

Incident Bot: [22:35:00] Incident resolved: logging-pipeline-delay marked RESOLVED by Sam.

Sam (oncall): signing off for now. If any pages come in, Priya is primary. Leaving links: runbook above, dashboard: https://dashboards.redwood.ai/logging/ingest-latency, playbook notes: https://wiki.redwood.ai/playbooks/region-fallthrough. Good handoff. :white_check_mark:
